name: application-save-status
title: Save Status Indicator
description: Auto-updating inline status text for autosave flows, cycling between a saving spinner, a saved checkmark, and a failed state with a retry action.
useWhen: The app autosaves changes in the background and users need a lightweight, glanceable confirmation.
You want to communicate save state without an intrusive toast for every successful save.
A save can fail and the user needs an inline way to retry without losing their place.
avoidWhen: Saves are explicit (a Save button with a page navigation or confirmation) — a toast or button loading state fits better than a persistent indicator.
The save operation is rare or high-stakes enough that a toast confirmation is more appropriate than an easily-missed inline text.
You need to show progress percentage, not just a binary saving/saved/failed state — use a progress bar instead.
responsiveBehavior: The indicator is an inline-sized flex row that wraps naturally inside toolbars, headers, or form footers at any width.
accessibility: Each state is wrapped in role="status" so assistive tech announces the change without requiring focus.
The failed state's retry action is a real button, not a link styled to look clickable, so it's keyboard-operable.
State is communicated through icon shape and text together, not through color alone.

variants.title: Saving
variants.description: In-progress state with a spinning icon and 'Saving…' text.
accessibility: role="status" announces the saving state to screen readers as it appears.

variants.title: Saving (Dark)
variants.description: Saving state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Spinner and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Saved
variants.description: Success state with a checkmark icon and 'Saved' text.
accessibility: Success is conveyed by both the checkmark icon and the visible 'Saved' text.

variants.title: Saved (Dark)
variants.description: Saved state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Checkmark and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Failed
variants.description: Error state with a warning icon, 'Failed to save' text, and an inline Retry button.
accessibility: The Retry action is a real <button>, reachable and activatable by keyboard.

variants.title: Failed (Dark)
variants.description: Failed state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Error text and retry link colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
